name: Dolphin Quantum Pro
description: A Maytronics Dolphin robotic pool cleaner positioned just below the Dolphin Premier in the "Best Seller" tier, cleaning in-ground and above-ground pools up to 50 ft with a top-load filtration basket, a 2-hour cleaning cycle, WiFi/app control via MyDolphin Plus, and sun-shelf/step climbing.

specs.label: Connectivity
specs.note: schedule cleans, switch modes, spot-clean, manual steering

specs.label: Cleans
specs.note: climbs shallow ledges/steps to ~12 in deep

specs.label: Filtration
specs.note: Ultra-Fine kit included; Super Ultra-Fine "S2" optional

sourcing: Verified against Maytronics' own official store pages for the Quantum Pro, Premier, and Sigma (maytronics.com, dolphinofficial.com) and The Pool Nerd's 2026 Dolphin lineup comparison and dedicated Quantum Pro review. This entry previously described an older, more basic "Dolphin Quantum" that explicitly lacked app/WiFi connectivity, treating a "Quantum Pro" variant as a separate SKU not to be confused with it; that distinction is now out of date — Maytronics' current lineup only sells this model as the "Quantum Pro," with the smart WiFi power supply, MyDolphin Plus app, and sun-shelf climbing bundled in as standard. Drive mechanism (tracks vs. wheels) is not specified in official materials and could not be confirmed. No confirmed launch date was found for the Pro rebrand, though it reads as an actively sold current model as of this research.

pricing.summary: Maytronics' own US store lists the Dolphin Quantum Pro at **$1,999** — the same price point the model held before its "Pro" rebrand — placing it below the Dolphin Premier ($2,499) and well below the flagship Dolphin Sigma ($2,999) in Maytronics' current lineup.

editorial.heading: Sensors & Hardware
editorial.body: Quantum covers in-ground and above-ground pools (50 ft), cleaning floor, walls, and waterline with two scrubbing brushes. Filtration is a top-load, extra-large fine-filtration basket with an included Ultra-Fine kit and optional Super Ultra-Fine "S2," but no full-filter indicator. Navigation is a "self-learning" pattern, not Premier's "CleverClean" branding. No app, WiFi, or Bluetooth. A "Quantum Pro" review's app-connectivity claim contradicts this.

editorial.heading: Insights
editorial.body: Maytronics has since folded what used to be a separate, more basic "Dolphin Quantum" into this "Quantum Pro" designation, adding WiFi/app connectivity (MyDolphin Plus) and sun-shelf/step-climbing capability that the earlier standard model lacked — the smart power supply and app control described here are a genuine feature addition, not a different SKU to be careful not to conflate. Reliable independent reviews of this exact current configuration are otherwise thin.

firmwareCommunity.note: Dolphin Quantum Pro has not released a public SDK, firmware repo, or developer API. Not currently listed in Builds & Mods.
